capabilities: Replace surah:ayah shorthand with verse text and translation
Choose translation language and translator from API options
Insert verses as an Obsidian callout, markdown table, or plain text
Search verses by word or phrase via API or offline store
Download the full Quran and translations for offline retrieval
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a search-only reference tool; its main job is replacing selected shorthand text in the note with formatted verse content.
extras: The parenthesis-removal feature is explicitly marked experimental; with offline mode off, verse retrieval depends on the free alquran.cloud API.
motivation: The author says he built it quickly "because I wanted this capability in my notes."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert Quran verses and translations into notes, so users would have to copy them manually from external sources.

relations.evidence: Notable mention, I styled this readme doc after theirs.

summary: Text-replacement plugin that expands surah:ayah shorthand into Quran verses with Arabic text and a chosen translation, inserted as callouts, tables, or plain text.
